title: Greetings fellow dreamers!
content: I'm new to this sub. Just heard about it and would like to contribute. I'm not caught up on everything in this sub but I would like to share my experiences. For about 2 decades I've been creating a dreamscape of my dreams to practice lucid dreaming. It is at the point where I'm lucid 4 times a night, every dream takes place in my dreamscape and new locations get added as they come. I'm working with ai to develop a 3d render of a top down perspective of it. Although I doubt they will resemble any shared environments. I've also been to some places (in my dreams) that I cannot explain. One of which I call "space prison". Looking forward to sharing my experiences as well as learning about all of yours! Cheers.
